meta.title: Inventory and allocation analyst at a multi-location resort retailer
meta.industry: Resort retail, six shops across two resorts
meta.blurb: Decides how stock moves between the warehouse and the shops, and keeps counts accurate.

opportunities.why: You pull stock levels from NetSuite for each shop and feed them into the replenishment report, so the same exports are reshaped each cycle.
opportunities.firstStep: Save the steps you repeat each cycle as a query, so next time the report refreshes from the new export.
opportunities.failureMode: A change in the source export's columns silently breaks the refresh.

opportunities.why: You rebuild the replenishment report in Excel on a schedule and email it to the buyer and store operations.
opportunities.firstStep: Save the steps you repeat each cycle as a query, so next time the report refreshes from the new export.
opportunities.failureMode: A change in the source export's columns silently breaks the refresh.

habits.name: Grouping similar tasks
becauseTasks: Excel: Plan transfers between shops, Build the weekly replenishment report, Reconcile shop counts with the system, Month-end inventory valuation
habits.firstStep: Put the tasks that use the same tool into one block on your calendar.
habits.failureMode: Blocks get booked over unless they are marked busy.

thin.taskName: Reconcile shop counts with the system

transcript.question: How many shops do you cover when you "Check stock levels by shop"?
For "Check stock levels by shop", where do you send or record what you find?
For "Build the weekly replenishment report", who receives the finished report?
transcript.answer: The buyer and store operations, by email, every Monday.

transcript.question: How many product lines or rows does the "Build the weekly replenishment report" usually cover?
For "Plan transfers between shops", where does the information come from, and who receives the plan?
options: From the replenishment report; sent to shops
From NetSuite stock data; sent to store operations
From shop managers' requests; sent to the warehouse
From the buyer; entered into NetSuite
transcript.answer: I pull NetSuite stock data and send the plan to store operations.
